items.summary:
OpenAI and Anthropic have tried to ​maintain a more open research culture to both ⁠attract employees and foster creativity that can lead to breakthroughs. The AI field is rooted in academia, where machine-learning scientists have openly discussed their research.

Some OpenAI employees are increasingly worried about this approach as AI grows more capable, according to the five people. [...] When asked about employees' concerns and their view that management did not act on these issues, OpenAI spokesperson Elana Widmann ​said that OpenAI is one of the most targeted organizations in the world. As a result, the company invests heavily in its security program to protect against attacks from insiders, cybercriminals and nation-states, she said. [...] The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here.

These workers argued that OpenAI's controls were so lax ‌that outsiders, including foreign governments, could obtain sensitive information about the AI lab's technology with relative ease, the people said. For example, anybody at OpenAI who could access its code could see the technical details underlying many company projects.

items.title: DeepSeek’s AI Agent Platform Reaches 1.54 Million Daily Active Users - Bloomberg
items.summary:
# DeepSeek’s AI Agent Platform Hits 1.54 Million Daily Users

DeepSeek, the Chinese AI disruptor, released striking adoption numbers for its AI agent infrastructure as it continues to challenge Anthropic PBC and OpenAI with an entire swath of applications built around open-source AI technologies. [...] On Sunday, the Hangzhou-headquartered startup disclosed on X that DeepSeek Harness, its open-source agent application, had reached 1.54 million daily active users by November 4, less than three months after its August 13 debut. Daily users were at about 271,000 at the end of September, right after it released a desktop version of the app, based on the number of users connecting to its own servers.

items.title: Who Owns DeepSeek, The Chinese AI Company?
items.summary: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek made headlines and caused disruption in the AI industry when it launched the R1 model in 2025. It uses a concept called mixture of experts (MoE) to efficiently generate AI responses at a much cheaper cost than its competitors. This resulted in the DeepSeek app becoming very popular in a short span of time. The R1 model launch triggered a global technology stock selloff in 2025 and made a clear statement to Western AI companies: China was by no means behind in the AI [...] DeepSeek's efficiency breakthroughs in AI compute could benefit the entire AI industry, which has an opportunity to learn from them to relieve the heavy resource needs of data centers that power most AI models. DeepSeek achieved its industry-leading efficiency through a combination of its MoE architecture, hardware optimization, model distillation, and reinforcement learning, which together lowered model training costs. [...] The company was founded by an electronic engineer from Zhejiang University named Liang Wenfeng, who funded the launch of DeepSeek with profits from his hedge fund, High-Flyer, in 2023. Liang co-founded High-Flyer, which uses math and AI to make investment decisions. In DeepSeek's second funding round, the company secured about $15 billion from large backers such as Tencent Holdings and CATL. 27% of this funding is state-owned, with the China National AI Industry Investment Fund contributing

items.title: People should always be in control of the future.
items.summary:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.

   - **Mô tả**: Nền tảng mã nguồn mở cho kỹ thuật AI cho các agent, LLM và mô hình ML. MLflow cho phép các nhóm ở mọi quy mô gỡ lỗi, đánh giá, theo dõi và tối ưu hóa các ứng dụng AI chất lượng sản xuất trong khi kiểm soát chi phí và quản lý quyền truy cập vào các mô hình và dữ liệu.  
   - **Sao**: 28,746 | **Forks**: 6,604 | **Vấn đề mở**: 2,223

2. **[google/adk-python](https://github.com/google/adk-python)**  
   - **Mô tả**: Bộ công cụ mã nguồn mở, dựa trên mã, cho việc xây dựng, đánh giá và triển khai các agent AI tinh vi với tính linh hoạt và kiểm soát.  
   - **Sao**: 22,173 | **Forks**: 4,331 | **Vấn đề mở**: 432

3. **[raga-ai-hub/RagaAI-Catalyst](https://github.com/raga-ai-hub/RagaAI-Catalyst)**  
   - **Mô tả**: SDK Python cho quan sát, theo dõi và đánh giá AI agent. Bao gồm các tính năng như theo dõi agent, llm và công cụ, gỡ lỗi hệ thống đa agent, bảng điều khiển tự lưu trữ và phân tích nâng cao với chế độ xem dòng thời gian và đồ thị thực thi.  
   - **Sao**: 16,194 | **Forks**: 3,572 | **Vấn đề mở**: 48

4. **[dataelement/bisheng](https://github.com/dataelement/bisheng)**  
   - **Mô tả**: BISHENG là một nền tảng Agent mã nguồn mở cho việc xây dựng, triển khai và quản lý các ứng dụng AI. Nó kết hợp các agent AI, quy trình làm việc, RAG và quản lý tri thức, tích hợp agent desktop và hosting ứng dụng vibecoding với quản lý mô hình thống nhất, đánh giá và quan sát.  
   - **Sao**: 12,217 | **Forks**: 2,016 | **Vấn đề mở**: 11

5. **[Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard](https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard)**  
   - **Mô tả**: Nền tảng Red Teaming AI toàn diện bảo vệ hệ sinh thái AI thông qua quét Agent, quét Kỹ năng, quét MCP, quét hạ tầng AI và đánh giá jailbreak LLM.  
   - **Sao**: 7,457 | **Forks**: 749 | **Vấn đề mở**: 26

Nếu bạn cần thêm thông tin hoặc muốn tìm hiểu sâu hơn về một repository cụ thể, hãy cho tôi biết!
